notes.title: Anima Flux at Nordic Game: Summary
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! Last week, the Anima Flux team attended Nordic Game in Malmö, Sweden. It was a pleasure to return to one of our most successful gaming conferences to make new acquaintances, meet old friends, as well as influencers, gaming enthusiasts, and media representatives.

The 20th-anniversary edition of the Nordic Game Conference from May 21 to May 24 brought many brilliant speakers and attendees from all over the world. With more than 2500 attendees on-site and 157 speakers from different countries, those were the main numbers of the past event.

Anima Flux participated in the speed game pitching, where about 30 game dev teams had to present their projects within 1 minute. We were pleased to receive a special mention from the hosts, highlighting our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/763180/announcements/detail/3675545798748673014?snr=2___]victory in the Pitch Battle last year[/url].

Over the course of 3 days, we showcased Anima Flux, among other indie game dev teams from European countries.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/b30e8d4c0d21f59a87f908f3c5c548d61d7ef1ee.png[/img]
Around 50 players enjoyed the game either in single or co-op mode, sharing their feedback with us. The majority of the audience noted the key features, including the visual style of the game and the fun co-op mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/dc8620f68ed38ad714560c4798c07996c773d458.png[/img]
The visuals remind them of old-school games in a sci-fi setting combined with cyberpunk elements. This impression is enhanced by the synthwave soundtrack, which intensifies as battles become more intense in the face of increasing threats.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/bce00f23af0524d90445b83cd53e19963f1598d7.png[/img]
Regarding combat, it became evident that the combat system and controls are easy to understand, proving a comfortable entry threshold into the gameplay for a wide audience. Many expressed the opinion that it would be a lot of fun to play the game together in couch co-op, joking and enjoying the story, visuals, and battles.

[previewyoutube=vXH_TsSW1uk;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]We would like to extend our thanks to the hosts of Nordic Game for this experience! It will be wonderful to come back here next year![/b]

Join our [url=https://discord.gg/xpxwzegj9f]Discord server[/url] to meet the devs and discuss the game!

notes.title: Anima Flux Big Demo Update!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

It's been quite a while since we last updated our game's demo version, but the time has finally come! We're excited to present to you a detailed breakdown of all the new features in the update (well, almost all of them), now available to everyone on Steam!

We've been hard at work refining and adding exciting new content, and we can't wait for you to dive in and experience it for yourselves. Whether you're a seasoned player or new to the game, we hope you'll enjoy what we've prepared for you.

So without further ado, fire up your Steam client and update your demo version now! And don't forget to let us know what you think – your feedback helps us continue to improve and polish the game to perfection.

[h3][b]Combat System Enhancements:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]New Abilities:[/b] Characters now have new abilities from the beginning of the game to diversify combat.
[*] Swordsman now has the [b]Stagger Attack[/b] - a lunging strike that stuns enemies in front of you. Stunned enemies take double damage from your regular attacks.
[img]https://media4.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExZGx3ejZsbDFmbmg0Z3k0NThqM2c1cms0eWd2aW13MGZsOGc2eTlxcCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/8E0trXqW5UZwUNC5fC/giphy.gif[/img]

[*] Archer's new [b]Rebound Attack[/b] - allows you to leap backward while firing an arrow, creating a short-lived decoy that absorbs enemy attacks.
[img]https://media2.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExems0MDE5NXR6eDYzczVwdWJtYjFscmJndHExZ294MGJyZ3JsOWI2diZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/7lmkGN3HQOHcMkNWzZ/giphy.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Empowered Special Attacks: [/b]Each character now has a gauge to enhance special attacks, which fills by meeting certain conditions.
[img]https://media2.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExdnFzbzlnNGlhZXhlOHh0MWs0Y3d6MjVieDd6eW1oM213OWk4cnF2NCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/d1p9MIOCe4pPBS3P2x/giphy.gif[/img]
[/list]
[h3][b]Improved Guide System:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] No more excuses for not learning the controls! A handy guide is now available in the pause menu, providing a clear overview of the basic gameplay mechanics.
[/list]

[h3][b]Enhanced Gameplay Experience:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Automatic Aiming:[/b] The archer now automatically locks onto the nearest enemy, while manual aiming remains available.
[*] [b]Button Buffer:[/b] Attacks, jumps, or dashes are automatically triggered after the previous action, enhancing fluidity in combat.
[*] [b]Gamepad Vibration:[/b] Feel the intensity of the battle with the new gamepad vibration options, which provide subtle feedback for minor damage and stronger pulses for heavy blows or character death.
[*] [b]Rage Mode Balancing:[/b] Unleash mayhem for extended periods with the rebalanced Rage Mode, which no longer stuns enemies but features a significantly longer duration and removes the previous penalty for early deactivation.
[/list]

[b]Note: [/b]This update includes various minor fixes and improvements to enhance overall gameplay experience.

notes.title: Anima Flux at Tokyo Game Show 2023. Traveler’s Diary
notes.notes:
Hey, dear followers!

Today we want to fill you in some details of our Tokyo trip and participation in the Tokyo Game Show 2023. It is no secret that this trade fair is one of the biggest in the world. And to become a part of such an event is a great honor. Especially for game developers. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/8e032b1cfad04cb737ea6d455001472e3be0c804.png[/img]

The first Tokyo Game Show ever held in 1996 and since then takes place in Makuhari Messe convention center, which includes 11 exhibition halls, a concert and an international conference hall. The event lasts for four days. First two are business days for networking with the representatives of gaming companies. The last two ones are the real treat for gamers. Tokyo Game Show is one of the most visited game shows in the world, and this year it reached 243.248 visitors. Impressive, isn’t it?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/ff077e4f59131b952ea352517af4ddb90c18df39.png[/img]

The Anima Flux team's task was to present our game as worthy as possible. And judging by the number of rave reviews, we made it. Representatives of large companies and people whose work we focused on while creating our game were interested in us. Another proof that we are going in the right direction. And this is good news.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/bea870f96ab3f19f57b5d534ad6a0635595bccc1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/31b625859e7443a8d5cdd7ad042cec962ac36822.png[/img]

About 50 people tested our game in total. Sometimes whole families would come up to us and play in co-op mode. Every second player gave us detailed feedback and thanks to them once we once again determined the vector of our work. There were also players who had not tested the games at the exhibition but noted the best for themselves. And, passing by our booth and noticing the description of our Metroidvania, they immediately wishlisted Anima Flux on Steam and set a reminder about the release of the free demo version of the game. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/5d09b1c1fbb5a18905bd0d15e21c57cf1f9da15e.png[/img]
[img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/5dcc85c68316e0d6aa881ffd2df54dd5c8350982.png[/img]

We would like to express special gratitude to everyone who took part in organizing the Tokyo Game Show. It is impossible to imagine how much people, resources and effort were spent on creating a real holiday for everyone who is interested in, loves and respects the gaming industry. We are incredibly excited to be a part of this amazing story. And we really hope to continue such an exciting adventure.

Thank you, hospitable Japan and Tokyo Game Show, for believing in us and giving us the opportunity to talk about our brainchild globally.

Stay tuned and enjoy our open demo!

notes.title: On the Highway to Release 7/14/2023

Hello, everyone!

In this article, we'd like to cast your mind back to some great results, we achieved this year.

During [b]Dev.Play[/b] our game was live-streamed and more than 3000 players got a chance to see the gameplay first!

We’re very proud that our game has been appreciated, and we’re keeping it up! 
With all the victories, contests, and streams we’ve had so much new energy that added a ton of new stuff. 

[b]New Character Look
[/b]
We announced Roy and Eileen’s new looks a while ago. Now it’s time to check them out in the game! 
How do you like them?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/e6780b51d1ee128f42a33776ccc1ead1e685c8d2.gif[/img]

[b]Cut Scenes[/b]
If you’re following us on social media, you must have seen the new Lost in Sky trailer. If you aren’t, it’s time to subscribe! :D

The trailer shows fine examples of future cut scenes in the game, among other things. Here’s one for you:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/a99a100f0e649f649628fab20a0bac1fce9e6125.gif[/img]


[b]Coop Camera[/b]
We tweaked it to improve interaction and your comfort during cooperative play.

notes.title: On the Highway to Release — 05/29/2020
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

May is coming to an end. We’d like to give you our final spring report before the summer comes into power! Today we are sharing new arts, screenshots, animations, and a piece of lore. Let’s go!
For starters, here’s something that’s still being developed.

[b]Pneumatic elevators
[/b]
Unlike conventional elevators, pneumatic ones can carry people and goods over very long distances at a high speed. We use them to quickly move around ARK.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/f73a761e9cdc8b445aab4aae3bf62c28d9d4dbab.jpg[/img]

It’s a pretty old technology, but it took us a while to make it safe for people to use. Nevertheless, the pneumatic network has existed for quite a while. Several Ark generations have can’t get around without it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/b4ff080d7adc61acfb2b2a4e995ee4a6c53d5339.jpg[/img]

[b]Hub gateway
[/b]
The ginormous hub has a lot of separate rooms, connected by the gateway. Use it to get from one section to another.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/705697f7a527f61f72222388f3dc1e9b41ccf998.gif[/img]

In case of danger, the gateway can be used for isolating Hub sections. It’s fast, easy, and reliable.

[b]Energy doors
[/b]
The energy doors have a functionality similar to the Hub gateway, but they look completely different.
They’re ordinary doors that look like energy barriers, used just like ordinary doors. You can find them in all kinds of public places, but rest assured, you don’t want them at home.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/31b1e7588f9c229893dd9cddca31b00839157310.gif[/img]

The energy doors are used in warehouses and labs. They’re transparent, and yet they isolate rooms completely. The latest versions are also soundproof.

That’s all about the Ark’s high-tech lore. Let’s turn our attention to something truly spectacular now.

[b]Creating monsters and interior elements
[/b]
Let's take a look at the process of creation of ARK system terminal and Chameleon.
We begin the creation of the system terminal with a sketch in our design document. A sketch, along with a short description, goes to the artist, who comes up with a few concepts. After one of them gets approved, the artist continues working on it until the team reaches a final version. This is the version that the players will see.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/01e71c5d8f439ceea6a49550f0cf28a834de9bb8.jpg[/img]

When we created Chameleon, we used an almost identical approach. There’s just one peculiarity: it was the monster that needed animations. This was a painstaking but highly engaging process. We were to create a realistic animation, looking as naturally as possible in the game world (if a mutant monster can look natural at all).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/aea4bde8bf33e901a8764843bc17ca265c21dc45.jpg[/img]

What’s more natural than a Kamikaze explosion? Perhaps, your desire to run as far away and as fast as you can! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/f7ecaeba3963beb4ddf26914b4f8c234c1f7d337.gif[/img]

Speaking of which, don’t you think that the owner of the pincer is just too handsy? Although… who knows what this thing really is? Maybe, it’s just the correct amount of “handsy”.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/82be86a47e7cc260791a670a8519b6dd222857b8.gif[/img]

And now to the summer! We’ll see you real soon.

notes.title: On the Highway to Release — 02/07/2020
notes.notes:
Hi, all!

We’ve been working hard to polish the Lost in Sky game universe based on your feedback. You can see the most obvious overhauls in our Developers’ Diary posts: the redesigned characters in cut scenes, new monster concepts, recolored locations.
It’s obvious that there’s a completely different way to show the Lost in Sky world. We can make it richer and deeper by adding more detail.

Today we want to show you the new concept art for the scenes we’re working on. Their atmosphere and mood are completely different, and you will feel it in every location you visit. 

[h2]Menagerie[/h2]

This level begins with the Headquarters. The external appearance is solemn and concise, with distinctive military flavor, dominated by light colors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/11c89daea6d7e18062cdf701c9fec45a788a891b.jpg[/img]

[h2]City[/h2]

The city is divided into several very different districts. 

[b]Enclosed urban area
[/b]
A corridor-type location, almost without windows. It features excessive artificial lighting, mainly in neon shades. The place is filled with screens showing bright videos.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/ab95c4562f345f0bedd9ab4ce31c22afa57b6ea8.jpg[/img]

[b]Elite apartments
[/b]
The uptown is the elite district. The architecture is concise and laconic, featuring huge spaces with hi-end furniture, home appliances, and decorations. The lighting is moderate. The information pollution level is kept at its minimum. This district hardly sustained any damage during the monster attack. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/5e0e7ccda350bcbafe942ffd1dc86f66fba9491b.jpg[/img]

[b]Lower class apartments
[/b]
The downtown wasn’t as lucky: there’s destruction and dead bodies everywhere. Apartments are small and tense, and extremely minimalistic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/274d58cad7819450567c262ee04d3a612038a37c.jpg[/img]

[h2]Industrial and military City districts
[/h2]
[b]Barracks[/b]

The military premises with bare walls. No unnecessary or brightly colored items. Everything is designed strictly by the book. The discipline and order are in the absolutes. These are special technical facilities for research and development.

[b]Presses
[/b]
This is the industrial area with furnaces, smelter, and conveyor belt. The place is full of heaps of scrap metal and broken automatic manipulators. Tipped tanks with spilled hot metal create additional obstacles on your way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/f47c2069fcfc2a6c5e98f30df548051f295c664b.jpg[/img]

This is just a small portion of our new concepts. We will continue with the new outlook on the Lost in Sky world and ARK. Share your opinions: tell us what you liked in particular and what you’d change. Your feedback is the fuel that drives us!

notes.title: On the Highway to Release — 01/10/2020
notes.notes:
Hi all!
 
The Lost in Sky team remembers the past year by the incredible show cases where players gave us a lot of useful feedback. We carefully evaluated and considered all the feedback we received and decided to go a completely different way with the game.

As you may have noticed on our social networks (by the way, sign up if you haven’t!), we’re constantly drawing, coloring, animating, and implementing many new monsters in the game. Why? It turns out, we don’t have enough different easy and intermediate enemies! We were overly fixated on bosses (but they’re good, aren’t they? Nothing was in vain) and forgot about the population of minor enemies.

The task isn’t as simple as it seems. It requires a comprehensive solution. For starters, we came up with a system for creating new monsters. All names, terms, and paragraphs you’ll see below are drafts and placeholders.

Firstly, we introduce a Family, which consists of up to ~4 species, for instance: 
[list]
[*] Larva
[*] Tadpole
[*] Youngling
[*] Mature
[/list]
Each Family will have a specific game mechanics (shooting, poisonous, flying, ground families, etc). The players can see how the Family members progress along the game: each next monster will be more dangerous than the previous. The older a family member, the more developed their unique family feature, the more difficult it is to defeat.

And now it's time to proceed to the color concept arts. Remember: appearance, name, and features are subject to change.

notes.title: On the Highway to Release — 09/13/2019
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

The past two months since our last update were fruitful. We visited Game Daily Connect 2019 in the USA. Distant flights, packed event days, and heaps of feedback! However, this doesn’t mean that we put the work on Lost in Sky on halt. Quite the opposite! We never stopped to work, and now we’d like to share the latest news with you.

[b]Color and lighting
[/b]

This was the biggest change in the recent weeks. We completely change the level color scheme and lighting. We’re also implementing new interior objects with parallax effect. The picture has become less “colorful” but acquired depth and distinctive atmosphere. And we’re being serious! Full stop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/77a9f172a0a5c990e0c1023e667dd29563dc7d50.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/869e1829c9d29147d34b9c057a13d9a61f5d2846.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/0fec60c8ad56dc66f65d3335aa593b1832dc138d.png[/img]

[b]Rage mode
[/b]

If follow us on social media, you should’ve seen the presentation of this new feature. In fact, it’s very simple yet effective. You will find a new bar in the character interface. This is the rage bar, and the rate of rage accumulation will depend on several factors: damage done, damage received, and special rage flasks consumed.

When the bar is full, the rage mode activates. This is where the hardships are relieved: you gain endless endurance and increased damage, while the effect lasts. You only need to find more enemies—but no worries, we’ll take care of it 😉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/1696b1156f0a2952157221d21408ab9d274426f5.gif[/img]

[b]Bot improvement
[/b]

We’re well aware that it one can’t always find a loyal friend to play co-op Lost in Sky with. We’re trying to teach our AI character if not to replace but at least resemble a living human being and imitate normal human behavior. We made a step toward the ultimate goal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/5288b1bfbe821f1b1edd6a5dc8f1ed7fdeb1a7d3.gif[/img]

[b]Random cues
[/b]

We focus on bubbles with cues that should replace big dialog windows covering your screen. Now players will receive incoming information non-stop along the course of action.
Characters can react with a cue to an enemy or a situation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/507bd22b75fca9ac5d807c0de499651903fb101e.gif[/img]

[b]Minor fixes
[/b]

With the latest reviews and suggestions from Game Daily Connect 2019, we’ve already started working on some new things:

- When a partner character dies in a co-op, your half of the screen expands full-screen. It’s simply too cruel to make you stare at your dead partner. And not very comfy, either.

- The enemies! Some thought they were sloppy. Others thought they were tough. We decided to give them some balance and ended up making them tough for everyone! Just joking. In fact, we’re following up on it, looking to find the right balance that every player would be okay with.

And that’s where the summer ends for the Lost in Sky team. We expect autumn to be no less eventful and rewarding.

Here’s a little something for you right from the development workshop. This is the redesigned Worm Boss location, creepy and depressing

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34001913/ced1a8ca9f6cf627b33616237f91bf9d9db60961.jpg[/img]

We’ll see you soon!

notes.title: On the Highway to Release — 07/12/2019
notes.notes:
Hi all! 

Since our last article we added a few cool features to Lost in Sky we'd like to share with you. We're really excited about them!

[b]Parallax effect 
[/b]

We added a frontal layer that moves past slower than the foreground layers, which adds depths to the scene. However weird this might sound, in fact, it's a very cool feature. Well, a picture's worth a thousand words!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/d5b680c8caa0b63a51d520ef3ce60582b720d253.gif[/img]

[b]Upgraded levers
[/b]

Levers got a new look, now they're easier to be seen. It takes just one glance to tell an enabled lever from a warden, an elevator, or a health kit. And from a disabled lever as well. Just in case: green means ON, red means OFF. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/3efeeee920c171568242242114bc875a4c32df99.gif[/img]

[b]Langoliers' new attack
[/b]

We decided that a repulsive look of a langolier isn't enough to show how much it is, in fact, hostile toward players. Now langoliers swell and become bright red just before they attack. There must be no doubt as to what is happening. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/ff7c587d81c92bd8f4d35b5de54be5ee91ffbc5a.gif[/img]

[b]Ally resurrection
[/b]

Lost in Sky's main feature is a two-character action. If one of them died, we had to restart the whole level. We thought that the survivor deserves a chance to go on on its own. Now, if one of the characters mistakes a langolier for a lever and dies, the other can find a resurrection point and bring their buddy back to life.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/144f98fbb93eab9d40717693df6a8d39e4cfd9d5.gif[/img]

[b]Stamina visuals
[/b]

We mentioned changes in Stamina system in one of our recent posts, so here are some quick facts. When you're about to run out of Stamina, here's what you see:

- the stamina bar blinks;
- Stamina level moves beyond the tick that indicates a low stamina warning;
- a white screen border appears.

Just a few minor things that might allow you to quickly notice that something's wrong. It's supposed to work like an insurance against situations, where you're surrounded by crowds of enemies—and you suddenly run out of Stamina. We hope it helps. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/e35080f746f3bfe10a3554c2e8e4919aa97ab3a1.gif[/img]

[b]Critical damage visualization
[/b]

It's easy. Old-school shooter style. When you character is almost dying, a red screen border appears, and your health bar starts blinking like crazy. Just like the Stamina thing, only red ¯\_(ツ)_/¯

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/c45c8d7b31e5749d05c0d1752d89ab116520b87e.gif[/img]

That's all for today! We'll come back to you with more cool stuff! Stay tuned!

notes.title: On the Highway to Release - Local Co-op Play
notes.notes:
Hi all!

We received tons of feedback after DevGamm and Casual Connect, the gaming conferences we took part in. A lot of your comments come down to saying, "We want the co-op mode!" This is why we dedicated all our time and energy to co-op mode development—and we've got something to show you. Dear players, we're happy to give you the Lost in Sky local co-op play mode!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/d9bcbe825e9f2fddfb5eb6c583934bbd1f6b95a8.jpg[/img]

The best way to implement it is the split screen, a thing you're pretty familiar with. The first iteration offers you a vertical split, where each player plays on their own side of the screen. We'll give a try to other options until we find a solution that works for everyone. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/754c950e5a7a01c53e4e1997addcaafa12af7380.jpg[/img]

Lost in Sky was intended as a game for two: whilst one player is fighting the enemy, the other supports them by pulling levers and pressing buttons. Basic game mechanics remain untouched, but now that you can play with your friend, it's more fun! 

Now, let's see how the local co-op mode can help you and your friend boost your gameplay.

A sword fighter chops off some scorpion's legs, protected by an arrow shooter from random spiders coming from behind.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/d3ed552d41151ecf06cc7fb9c7f9285147e7b56c.gif[/img]

Classic: a character presses a button to open a trap door, while the other shoots off the attackers.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/74a6a3be86ca93a9ab49772ff92c61751cba071b.gif[/img]

Eileen runs across the top to activate the elevator, otherwise unavailable to Roy.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/ae3e59b11dc7e4021d3eba6205efac029d4f9ae9.gif[/img]

The arrow shooter drops a health kit for Roy, who got badly hurt in a battle.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/a65b0436d14f6a41f08735767d7e615d67544e81.gif[/img]

These are just a few examples of Lost in Sky teamplay. There's still room for perfection, so we're still working on many things here. 

One of them is dynamic split screen, where the two sides of the screen become whole when both characters meet and split into two when they're apart. Who likes to see a double set of characters on the screen, right? The dynamic split screen makes the whole thing look much better! As you may probably have noticed, this feature is already working but could use some more polishing. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/ed0187fbb390e324beb5c032d38841931bc2285e.gif[/img]

We can't wait for you to try out the power of team co-op play! That's why we're working on it as fast as we only can. Stay tuned! See you in the upcoming updates!

notes.title: On the highway to release — Combat system overhaul
notes.notes:
Hi all!

Today we are going to tell you about our work on the combat system in Lost in Sky. 

In this update, we stuck to several basic ideas:

[list]
[*] Making the combat more realistic and spectacular;
[*] Making the battles more dynamic and aggressive;
[*] Encouraging player's quick reaction and turning down the reluctant playstyle.
[/list]

Here's what we implemented:

[b]Characters' basic and power blows[/b]

The new animations made the combat even more realistic. Roy puts all his bodyweight in a sword blow, and Eileen bends her bow with all the might. Attacks look sharper, swifter, and more threatening than before.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/12e483b482f3ce6479665cc4409d98b105c350a0.gif[/img]

However, we wouldn't want to turn the game into one big hack-and-slash no-brainer. Characters stop after dealing a blow or shooting an arrow. This encourages the player to watch the attack timers and choose the exact moment to deal another blow. We'll be monitoring this mechanic and fixing it if needed.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/29c326949d74b72febcc0ba67eef8af7420cf34e.gif[/img]

[b]Stamina[/b]

We had to redesign the stamina system to support the rapid combat. Now characters consume stamina very quickly, but it restores in no time.

[b]Dash[/b]

Each character now has a unique, specific blow:

Roy makes a short dash to zip between the targets in combat

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/cd3836e3f992cdbcf8ba72a0ff0bd21373c268c8.gif[/img]

Eileen's dash has become longer. Now she can jump forward and shoot the enemy that's following her.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/f7543f5f66e9f727bb2d09335dd8d9562ba34045.gif[/img]

In addition, all dashes now consume less stamina, and you can use them more often. 

[b]Monsters[/b]

We speeded up the gameplay and the characters, so we couldn't leave the monsters behind. Their cooldowns and behavior were upgraded and enhanced. Now they can run faster and hit more accurately.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/ad06a1a304ebbf037c1b61116b51abd9aac7e82d.gif[/img]

Moving is living. With the new rapid gameplay, our players have a real reason to live up to this slogan! 

We'll see you soon!

notes.title: On the Highway to Release - the Sewers
notes.notes:
Hi all!

Our protagonists are descending deeper into Ark's underlying structures to understand how massive the damage was. Today we'll have a look at a location called the Sewers, with the new scenery, new mechanics, and, of course, enemies.

The Sewers. The undercity. It has never seen a lot of visitors, apart from patrols and maintenance staff. This influenced the way the location looks. Unlike Barracks, it doesn't have much gore or dead bodies. A complex structure of pipes, pools and puddles in the corridors, flooded rooms—that's what the characters see when they first get to this location. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/75e1e205ca34833d81cdd306d919d7b985f370d8.jpg[/img]

Water is a great basis for some new mechanics.

[b]Puddles on the floor.
[/b]

They're pretty shallow, ankle-deep, but they slow down the characters' movement speed, making them more exposed to danger. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/8eeb713c3e39f0f020350367939f8023df53391d.gif[/img]

[b]Flooded rooms.
[/b]

Whole sectors were flooded after the mutant attack, and life-support systems went out of order. Such rooms are impossible to walk through without special equipment. First you must drain them with special pumps. Sometimes the obstacle is too big, and you need to drain it in several rounds to be able to pass.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/308660baec8924e4ca25f8feca7bb7e951feff05.gif[/img]

The sewers collected excess water and ARK's sewage. Water purification system allowed to filter out clear water and waste and reuse them. The attack put the purification system out of order, and contagious water flooded the premises.  All this affected the monsters that dwell in the Sewers. 

[b]Flying fish.[/b]

Large specimen, whose fins mutated into some sort of tentacles.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/a86d2b60429b58a3a39fd041dc51dbb021f6dd41.jpg[/img]

[b]Exploding bugs and worms.[/b]

Toxic liquid had an unexpected impact on bugs and worms. The survival mechanism was replaced with uncontrollable rage and an urge to kill. As soon as a mutant spots an enemy, it goes berserk and makes a suicidal attack, its toxic blood explodes and contaminates everything in the area. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/e1373660924152789e424541bb77cf24af07ecf2.jpg[/img]

As you see, water isn't only a source of life, but it also may cause big trouble. Can it get any nastier on ARK? Stay tuned, and you will find out! See you soon.

notes.notes:
Hi all! 

Today we'll tell you about a place that used to belong to a caste of brave warriors. These days this place is good for shooting a horror movie. You might have guessed that the place is the Barracks.

Before the mutant onslaught, Barracks were a training camp and a campus for brave soldiers, defenders of Ark. One of the Lost in Sky's main characters Roy also spent quite a bit of time here, together with his fellow soldiers. Long training sessions and warcraft studies have done their job. The Ark warriors are rightfully considered the elite unit. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/d1116f8dd861e4dbea4df768c323d496e60e9ba1.jpg[/img]

Today the Barracks look menacing. There's blood, and gore, and human bodies, and pools of slime, and cocoons, dangling from the ceiling. The mutants damaged some life-support system energy generators during their attack. The electricity cuts are only making the dark picture worse.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/7a9aecfe5c798a8f1952f01a895181f9ab25678a.jpg[/img]

The spacious and now gloomy rooms are a great place for langoliers and giant hornets to dwell. In case some of you forgot, langoliers are flying creatures that look like fish. They live and attack in packs. The mutants nosedive on characters, emitting clouds of deadly gas and inflicting huge damage over the area.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/cb73b586cfb103e5bc19970f46806ed1d725da1e.gif[/img]

Hornets are dangerous because of their enormous size and rapid onset. A flyer attacks, ramming you with a poisonous stinger in the rear part of their body.  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/32d3a6146d52696295b4b1c0ad908f22368df9a6.gif[/img]

You might find something useful in the Barracks. Don't forget that warriors used to live here, after all. You will discover grenades as you walk through the level. They are metal spheres that can be thrown from a short distance and rebounded from a wall. They explode a few seconds after a throw and deal damage over the area. They're very efficient against packs of enemies.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/272625559176b906c582f79f756aa2de1a488784.gif[/img]

Barracks is the place where Roy's hearth and home used to be. He spent almost his entire life here, and now he hopes to find survivors. The question is, are there any survivors at all?

We'll see you again in two weeks!

notes.title: On the Highway to Release - the Presses
notes.notes:
Hi all!

Here's something brand new for the brand new year! Today we'll have a look at some new levels with curious game mechanics. 

First and foremost, it's conveyor belts, that are moving continuously in a specified direction. If you move along with the belt, your movement speed significantly increases, and you'll get past this area very quickly. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/b9e3c603042a62e921c1c558cbbd0912ab19f9e5.gif[/img]

Should you choose to move in the opposite direction, your character will slow down and struggle to walk. It's less efficient, but sometimes you must do it to find a better way or survive.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/78943b223e6ad2d01c77d45b79b657262b090aeb.gif[/img]

The belts look welcoming and almost safe, except for one thing. The hydraulic presses. They're horizontal. They're vertical. They're fast. They're slow. They're big and deadly. We have one for every taste. 

Combinations of the moving belt and presses confront you with a choice: try and slide under the press at full speed or step backwards and wait for a good moment to dash.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/d2c4452377f8cfefad30d879387ff007bab59077.jpg[/img]

If you aren't a fan of risky and reckless solutions, we have the third major option for you: teamplay. You can easily find pressure platforms and levers that switch the deadly pillars' frequency. While one character is standing on a pressure platform or gripping on a lever, the other may pass. Nevertheless, it's not a walk in the park. One successful hit of a press, and you're pancaked. Think twice before you leap. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/0c7b732ce6060a0bbed8df4b43ef82608d90f3f1.gif[/img]

We also thought you can use a friendly support of enemies, breathing down your neck, to help you take your decisions faster. Since we have new mechanics and new levels, it's only natural to introduce a couple of new enemies. Ladies and gents, we give you...

The Spider

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/aa9d995596ded66e3d893ac220921cbf90a8b78c.jpg[/img]

This mutant jumps on your head out of the blue just when you are standing on a very important pressure button. While you deal with it, your partner still has a chance to make it to the end of the conveyor belt—but not in the same shape as you last saw them. Shooting them before going out may save the day.

The Worm

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/2efde45b809a92feee8cb8a72ca8c4b9cd2077da.jpg[/img]

A very stubborn thing. It will ram you with its jaws time and again until it kills you. They usually attack in packs, and they'll do everything to prevent you from getting somewhere you're dying to get (pun intended). Roy's swing against them looks especially stunning. 

We added a lot of secret shortcuts for those who like leaving things to chance. Some of them will help you bypass a hot spot. Others will lead you straight into an ambush. Is it worth the risk? It's up to you to decide.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/bf7fdd517f1cb3a3617476519fd1365fa07675ca.jpg[/img]

And so we turn the first page of the year 2019! How do you like it? Share your feedback and opinions!

See you in two weeks!

notes.title: On the Highway to Release - the City
notes.notes:
Hi all! 

As promised, today we're going to tell you about the City, the cradle of the future. This is the place that unites technology and religion. It's the home for most Ark's people. Nobody was prepared for an assault on the City.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/b42f04b96f7e7e38170e89e96d7eaadd4b460a19.jpg[/img]

The City is multi-level complex location that requires solo game. While one character explores the skyscrapers, the other should fight their way through the dark cellars. There are many options to move around the level. You can opt for the elevators that go up and down, cling to numerous ledges, climb the stairs, or walk around the network of chambers.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/2396fca7a8470896b634574c9349f2aa70bdcaf3.jpg[/img]

The upper levels of the City with all the billboards, inviting neon signs, tall buildings of glass, and neat and green recreation areas are the peak of the future civilization. However, stains of blood, burning fire, and devastation give a broad hint to the catastrophe that took place here. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/8d1be10c44b2c8bf3f08668e7db782d2ef82d700.jpg[/img]

Cellars evoke a different mood. They were less presentable and groomed, because the citizens used them mainly as technical facilities, storage, and for production purposes. Mutants got here before they could reach the upper city. Their presence certainly made this unpleasant place even nastier. Faulty lighting that occurred after the enemy onslaught will give a hard time to anyone who chooses to descend to the cellars.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/88060ecc5f0ff099d123a9097746018e724d9c76.jpg[/img]

You will meet few survivors in the City, representatives of different layers of the future society. Men and women, children and elderly people, they're all civilians, united by the threat of horrible monsters. They will tell you the whole story of what happened here. Some of them may even give the main characters a quest. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/804847e3aef90b1851e4e790126ccddf4a961d9c.jpg[/img]

Many life-support systems are out of order after the mutant attack. People are very short of vital resources, such as water and oxygen. While the operational section of the City's AI, Miss Oliver, is trying to restore the life-support systems, Roy and Eileen are on the mission to protect the City against the enemy, clean up the occupied sectors, and save the human survivors.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/dd1d495a20577c8b9d90d20bda4809245775b0f0.jpg[/img]

The major challenge here is that the dangerous creatures, attacking people, have mutated and gained the ability to multiply very quickly. This evolutionary model allows them to survive in every condition. This is why the mutants would lay their eggs, cocoons all over they City. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/ca2e56131dae648e5d65afb0f65e4568019b8547.png[/img]

Cocoons can be located on the ceiling or on the floor. They can contain embryos, or even a pleasant surprise. Some of them block passages, or spawn monsters, or just stay dormant till better days. There's no way to know which of them is in front of you.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/7787dd041c84b6177ecf5c1fdad922d391af8f8f.gif[/img]

How did the mutants made this incursion into the very heart of the human civilization? What are the warriors fighting to protect in the Hub, the following location beyond the City? Why are the monsters forcing their way to the Hub so fiercely? What is hidden in the priests' secret laboratories? All of this and much more remains to be seen.

The Lost in Sky team wishes you a merry Christmas and a happy New Year!

Stay tuned and see you soon!

notes.title: On the Highway to Release - 12/07/2018
notes.notes:
The great spaceship ARK is cruising through the space in the distant future. This planet-spaceship is made up of multiple biomes, inhabited by humans and mutated deadly beasts.

Over the centuries of wandering the humanity lost its goal and the former level of technology. Owing to the dictatorship of a group of priests, headed by the Creator's AI, the City, ARK's core and the pillar of industrial civilization, remains the only place preserving bits and pieces of the lost knowledge.

All of a sudden, mutated monsters from the Jungle invade the city. Security system crash leads to a bloody massacre, which only the heroes of the warrior caste can stop.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/3452bf00db75143253ac03867815f5ea9af92407.png[/img]

In addition to mutant hordes, the player will face the mysteries of ARK laboratories, which calls into question the very human nature. What is a human? Is it the indomitable spirit or genetic carrier, hostage to the masters of the evolution, run by them from behind the ARK's scenes?

This is the basis of the Lost in Sky: Violent Seed story—the game we're telling you about today. 

[h1][b]Main characters
[/b][/h1]

Let us introduce you to the main characters, responsible for protecting the remains of the humanity, the mission that seems impossible at the first glance.

Roy M., the Swordsman. An elite melee warrior from Ark captain's private security team. Absolute combat skills enable him to confront any threat.   

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/9cd4c3f13e554a342cac195fd0b762aa0de02d0e.png[/img]

[b]Strike [/b]

Snaps all types of enemies like twigs, but consumes stamina. Mind your combat strategy in this regard.
A mastery of melee weapons allows to effectively defeat any enemy.


[b]Power strike[/b]

Good for smashing cages and supply boxes or kicking back the enemies. Of course, it requires measuring the distance to the enemy and careful timing to prepare the blow.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/239e5635c47a8f844b324a212a5623463513b507.gif[/img]

[b]Jump strike [/b]

Effectively takes down airborne enemies. 


[b]Dash strike[/b]

A situation that is about to go out of control requires a super strike. Sweeping away all enemies from your way feels nice and works well. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/bc7b0f9334bb36692c3d093cac0a2d578dc6eac9.gif[/img]


Another character is Eileen, the Archer, who deals ranged damage. Her sharp eyes and quick shot spell trouble.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/ae2b5ceb68be3851371d0d81a0e548a94ef277e6.png[/img]

These are her combat abilities:

[b]Shot
[/b]

Why approaching an enemy in an uphill battle if you can simply take them down from a safe distance? 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/71acbee8a077fcc27d6ce90eb1a2a1d113074b85.gif[/img]

[b]Power shot[/b]

Deals huge damage, but consumes more stamina.


[b]Fan shot [/b]

It's the super ability: EIleen shoots a massive fan of arrows. There can't be too many good arrows. 


[h1][b]Enemies[/b][/h1]

Monsters in the Lost in Sky world can walk, fly, crawl, and attack in many different ways. The range of assorted troubles they'll be causing you is very wide.

[b]Langoliers 
[/b]

Petty, annoying, seemingly chaotic flying creatures. They may attack you one at a time or in a swarm. 

Check out their sketches:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/2bf4012a95682c72c68e7aed953f7d1754d60980.png[/img]

[b]Scorpios[/b]

Quite the tricksters. They can jump and bite, and the smartest of them can burrow for a devious attack. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/708c71f9c7cfd3474e77e07d7fd35dad6564a739.png[/img]

[b]Spiders [/b]

Cowardly and reserved by nature, they spit on you from a distance, travel by their cobwebs, and avoid close encounter at all costs. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/a8b64a5fd44b90209a91a25a1b80231744fca71c.png[/img]

[b]Worms [/b]

Slow, but nasty. If it fails to bite you, it'll explode. No good either way. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/3c95bd9c13d355fa6c6ae107f37887fdc7adb90f.png[/img]

[h1][b]Teamwork [/b][/h1]

Depending on the character you control, Roy or Eileen, you may command your partner to follow or hold position. You an also share a health kit or simply have a chat. 

The gameplay is based on your cooperation and interactions with the game mechanics (levers, push plates) as a team. You can never go alone. Always invite a friend or two. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/540391f981c7c728ab014a2bba0009d2a0e23b99.gif[/img]

One or more combat turrets can be a part of your team. It makes fighting your way through the crowd of enemies so much easier.    

[b]Levels [/b]

At the beginning the players will attend a briefing in the Menagerie training camp. You will practice your combat skills and prepare for the upcoming mission.

The Menagerie in the middle of the City of the Future is where they keep the beasts from the Jungle and other Ark biomes. Caste warriors hold their special practice rounds there. However, the priests remain silent about the real purpose of keeping the beasts in the heart of the secure city.

Menagerie is an endless maze with lots of floors, passages, and platforms. The lighting is malfunctioning because part of city life-support systems is failing, causing the red emergency lights to kick in. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/b1b854a34216bcd45bb50cd39d3d2f395ecfd39e.gif[/img]

The caged monsters are trying to break out and tear in half everyone who dares standing in their way.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34001913/4aa249b0880f741673bfdeb3b2215c9682a4c5a9.png[/img]

Our next article will cover the City, the cradle of future civilization, with beautiful neon lights on the surface and grim and gloomy inside, in the dark underground passages. 
 
Stay tuned and see you soon!
